artifacts.summary: Phase 0 gate for TM-star: machine-checked schema list for the time registers, the refutation of modal_future over StarFormula, the failure of both erasure routes, the conditional/contrapositive account of TM-plus conservativity, the unconditional L-subset-L-star conservative-extension row, and TM-star completeness recorded as unreachable with its obstruction named.

user_decision.question: Should StarAxiom embed the TM-plus axiom set via a single ofBase constructor (TM schemata available only at register-free instances), or re-declare all 45 TM schemata over StarFormula (every instance available, but ~45 direct validity plus swap-validity proofs because atomization cannot exist for L-star)?
options: ofBase embedding - Phase 2 soundness for the TM block is two lines; TM temporal schemata hold only at register-free instances
Full re-declaration over StarFormula - every schema instance available; costs roughly 45 direct validity and 45 swap-validity proofs over StarTruthAt, i.e. several extra phases
user_decision.recommended: ofBase embedding - Phase 2 soundness for the TM block is two lines; TM temporal schemata hold only at register-free instances
